# NPCs — Index

<!-- Generated by .claude/scripts/build_index.py on 2026-11-07 — do not edit by hand -->

← [[campaign/curse-of-strahd/README|Curse of Strahd]] · [[README|Evangelina Penitentia]]

```dataview
TABLE WITHOUT ID
  link(file.path, default(aliases[0], file.name)) AS "NPC",
  disposition AS "Disposition",
  status AS "Status",
  choice(location, link(location), "") AS "Location",
  choice(faction, link(faction), "") AS "Faction",
  sessions AS "Sessions",
  file.etags AS "Tags"
WHERE file.folder = this.file.folder AND file.name != this.file.name
SORT default(aliases[0], file.name) ASC
```
